description:
Why are the world's most powerful AI models suddenly putting hard limits on how much you can use them? While tech giants promised a future of infinite, cheap artificial intelligence, the brutal reality of AI scaling limits, soaring energy costs, and a strategy called "Tokenmaxxing" is forcing Big Tech to quietly ration access.

The industry is hitting a wall, and the $20-a-month subscription model is officially breaking. Watch as we uncover the hidden crisis inside OpenAI, the real reason your message limits are shrinking, and how physical energy grids and data collapse are dividing the future of AI into exclusive, high-priced tiers.
